name: JoAi: List Social Accounts

description.en: List the social profiles and Facebook Pages the team can publish to.
description.de: Liste die Social-Profile und Facebook-Seiten auf, auf denen das Team veröffentlichen kann.

bot: Use this before creating a post when the team has more than one connected profile or Facebook Page. Each connection has platform, connected, displayName, and accounts[]. Pass the chosen accounts[].id as accountId to create_social_post. Omit accountId to use the default profile.
